title: Identify players who are taller than 170 cm and have at least one attribute
question: Identify players who are taller than 170 cm and have at least one attribute record on '2014-10-10'. Among these, compute their average heading accuracy and average overall rating from all attribute records between 2013 and 2015 (inclusive). Only include players whose average heading accuracy exceeds 65 and whose average overall rating is above 70. Additionally, exclude any player whose name appears in a comparison where another player has both a higher average overall rating and higher average heading accuracy (i.e., keep only non-dominated players by these two metrics). Return the player names ordered first by average heading accuracy descending, then by average overall rating descending, limited to the top 15.

arguments.sql:
WITH qualified_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p."XCL_122" AS player_api_id
  FROM Player AS p
  WHERE p."XCL_126" > 170
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
      WHERE pa."XCL_130" = p."XCL_122"
        AND pa."XCL_131" = '2014-10-10 00:00:00'
    )
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p."XCL_122" AS player_api_id,
    p."XCL_123" AS player_name,
    AVG(pa."XCL_139") AS avg_heading_accuracy,
    AVG(pa."XCL_132") AS avg_overall_rating
  FROM Player AS p
  INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
  WHERE p."XCL_122" IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM qualified_players)
    AND pa."XCL_131" >= '2013-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND pa."XCL_131" <= '2015-12-31 23:59:59'
  GROUP BY p."XCL_122", p."XCL_123"
  HAVING AVG(pa."XCL_139") > 65
     AND AVG(pa."XCL_132") > 70
),
non_dominated AS (
  SELECT ps.*
  FROM player_stats AS ps
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM player_stats AS other
    WHERE other.player_api_id <> ps.player_api_id
      AND other.avg_overall_rating > ps.avg_overall_rating
      AND other.avg_heading_accuracy > ps.avg_heading_accuracy
  )
)
SELECT player_name
FROM non_dominated
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC, avg_overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 15

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH qualified_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p."XCL_122" AS player_api_id
  FROM Player AS p
  WHERE p."XCL_126" > 170
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
      WHERE pa."XCL_130" = p."XCL_122"
        AND pa."XCL_131" = '2014-10-10 00:00:00'
    )
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p."XCL_122" AS player_api_id,
    p."XCL_123" AS player_name,
    AVG(pa."XCL_139") AS avg_heading_accuracy,
    AVG(pa."XCL_132") AS avg_overall_rating
  FROM Player AS p
  INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
  WHERE p."XCL_122" IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM qualified_players)
    AND pa."XCL_131" >= '2013-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND pa."XCL_131" <= '2015-12-31 23:59:59'
  GROUP BY p."XCL_122", p."XCL_123"
  HAVING AVG(pa."XCL_139") > 65
     AND AVG(pa."XCL_132") > 70
),
non_dominated AS (
  SELECT ps.*
  FROM player_stats AS ps
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM player_stats AS other
    WHERE other.player_api_id <> ps.player_api_id
      AND other.avg_overall_rating > ps.avg_overall_rating
      AND other.avg_heading_accuracy > ps.avg_heading_accuracy
  )
)
SELECT player_name
FROM non_dominated
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC, avg_overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 15

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH qualified_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pa."XCL_130" AS player_id
  FROM Player p
  INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
  WHERE p."XCL_127" > 170
    AND pa."XCL_131" = '2014-10-10 00:00:00'
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p."XCL_122" AS player_id,
    p."XCL_123" AS player_name,
    AVG(pa."XCL_132") AS avg_heading,
    AVG(pa."XCL_138") AS avg_overall
  FROM Player p
  INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
  WHERE p."XCL_122" IN (SELECT player_id FROM qualified_players)
    AND pa."XCL_131" >= '2013-01-01'
    AND pa."XCL_131" <= '2015-12-31'
  GROUP BY p."XCL_122", p."XCL_123"
  HAVING AVG(pa."XCL_132") > 65
     AND AVG(pa."XCL_138") > 70
),
non_dominated AS (
  SELECT ps.*
  FROM player_stats ps
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM player_stats other
    WHERE other.player_id != ps.player_id
      AND other.avg_overall > ps.avg_overall
      AND other.avg_heading > ps.avg_heading
  )
)
SELECT player_name
FROM non_dominated
ORDER BY avg_heading DESC, avg_overall DESC
LIMIT 15
